summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Crowd Flow Optimiser (CFO) after de-vibecoding refactor (lifespan migration, TS conversion, 5 new features). Ran the existing pytest suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (24 tests) - ALL PASS. Executed a Playwright end-to-end script against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering: preset skeleton→cards render, run simulation, HF AI suggestions, PDF/CSV export on both Scenario and AI Reroutes tabs, pan/zoom buttons, keyboard shortcuts (Space/Arrow/Escape), and URL state persistence across reload. All 5 new features work and zero console errors observed.

issues: play-toggle-btn has no aria-label; screen-reader users cannot tell Play vs Pause state (functional toggle still works via Space; test verified state change by checking scrubber label movement).

action_items: (Optional) Add aria-label to [data-testid=play-toggle-btn] that reflects Play/Pause for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py, ai_service.py, simulation.py and presets.py are well-structured, use env vars, exclude Mongo _id and use async correctly.
Frontend TypeScript conversion is clean; components under /components use data-testid consistently and every interactive element in scope has a testid.
URL state persistence writes back after preset load, so on first visit the URL is populated with defaults - this is fine, matches spec (shareable link).
Downloads work via jspdf/blob anchor; both Scenario and AI-Reroutes export buttons trigger the same underlying exportPDF/exportCSV - filenames are venue-scoped, no duplicates.
d3-zoom is wired into VenueCanvas and the +/-/reset buttons plus wheel/drag work without console errors.
seed_data_creation: TestCustomVenue uploads a tiny TEST_ prefixed layout via POST /api/venues; no persistent seed data is committed - MongoDB entries live only for the run's simulation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in <5s (pytest-xdist, 2 workers) and covers health/presets/simulate/custom-venue/reroute-suggestions including the HF AI vs fallback source and 422/404 negative paths. Playwright verified preset skeletons, run→scrubber→AI Reroutes tab auto-switch, PDF/CSV downloads on BOTH Scenario tab (export-pdf-btn/export-csv-btn under [data-testid=export-section]) and AI Reroutes tab (export-pdf-btn-suggestions/export-csv-btn-suggestions), zoom-in/out/reset buttons, keyboard shortcuts (Space toggles play, ArrowLeft/Right steps timeline, Escape closes panel and open-panel-btn appears), and URL state (venue/people/curve/steps/start query params written on scenario change and restored on reload). HF AI is currently reachable and returns source='ai' for stadium_egress bottleneck steps.
